banner.restarting: metabox is restarting. The panel reconnects on its own in a few seconds.
banner.unreachable: metabox is not responding. The panel shows the last loaded data; changes cannot be applied.
banner.schema: metabox is newer than the panel: some data may not show. Reload the page.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.message: Check the address in the browser — the panel has no such section.

error.description: This section failed to open because of an error in the panel itself. The config and sing-box on the router are not affected.

drift.newer: The router runs sing-box {{binary}}, the forms target {{schema}}. Edit new fields in “Whole config as text”.
drift.older: The router runs sing-box {{binary}}, the forms target {{schema}}. A field it does not know fails the check on apply.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.description: They work when focus is not in a text field.

keys.add: Add an item: a rule, a rule set, a node
keys.addCustom: Rule sets: add your own list
keys.apply: Open the summary of changes before Apply
keys.nodes: On the title of an open node: the neighbouring node
keys.close: Close the panel or the dialog
